question: เมื่อใช้ artificial hormone state ที่เปลี่ยนช้าเพื่อปรับ phase increment ของ SO(2) CPG เทียบกับ fixed-parameter baseline จะเปลี่ยนความถี่ nod ที่วัดได้และ tracking error ของแกน nod ในโคมปฏิสัมพันธ์จำลองและบน hardware ที่สอบเทียบแล้วอย่างไร
hypothesis: ภายใต้ source interaction trace เดียวกัน AHM condition ที่มี H เพิ่มจาก 0 ไปยัง steady state จะเพิ่ม phi จาก 0.20 ไปไม่เกิน 0.40 rad/update และเพิ่มความถี่ CPG/nod เมื่อเทียบกับ fixed phi=0.20; tracking error ไม่ควรเพิ่มเกินขอบเขตที่กำหนดล่วงหน้า 10% ของ amplitude target ใน simulation และต้องประเมินใหม่จาก hardware จริง การคาดการณ์นี้เป็น hypothesis ของ proposed course model ไม่ใช่ผลที่ยืนยันแล้ว
biological_inspiration_source: แนวคิด artificial hormone mechanism สำหรับการปรับการเดินเมื่อสภาพ terrain เปลี่ยน: Homchanthanakul, J., Ngamkajornwiwat, P., Teerakittikul, P., and Manoonpong, P. (2019), Neural Control with an Artificial Hormone System for Energy-Efficient Compliant Terrain Locomotion and Adaptation of Walking Robots, IEEE/RSJ IROS, pp. 5475-5482, DOI https://doi.org/10.1109/IROS40897.2019.8968580. โครงงานยืมแนวคิดตัวแปรภายในที่ปรับช้าเท่านั้น ไม่อ้างว่า H เป็นฮอร์โมนชีวภาพจริงหรือจำลองสมการ paper โดยตรง
independent_variable: การใช้ AHM-modulated phase increment เทียบกับ fixed phase increment โดยคง CPG, input trace, pose bounds, output scheduling และจุดเริ่มต้นเหมือนกัน
AHM_equation: Proposed course Euler model adapted from Lab04: R_old=clamp((H_old-H_min)/(H_max-H_min),0,1); P=k_prod*S; C=k_clear*H_old; B=k_bind*R_old; H_new=clamp(H_old+dt*(P-C-B),0,1); R_new=clamp(H_new,0,1). H เป็นสถานะไร้มิติ ไม่ใช่ระดับฮอร์โมนชีวภาพ
SO2_CPG_equation: Course SO(2) recurrence (Week05/Lec5 slide 18 as referenced by Lab03): a1(t+1)=alpha[cos(phi)o1(t)+sin(phi)o2(t)]; a2(t+1)=alpha[-sin(phi)o1(t)+cos(phi)o2(t)]; o1(t+1)=tanh(a1); o2(t+1)=tanh(a2). Update uses both old outputs simultaneously.
integration_description: Implemented as a separate offline proposed-course-model experiment in ahm_cpg_project.py: at each 0.05 s CPG update AHM output R sets phi=clamp(0.20+0.20*R,0.10,0.45) rad/update; alpha remains 1.10. CPG output maps to semantic nod target q_nod=0.10*o1 rad with an explicitly proposed first-order semantic actuator model (tau=0.15 s, slew bound 0.8 rad/s). This is not integrated into the seven-topic ROS bridge or a physical actuator; the FSM/ROS integration remains proposed work.

conditions.name: C0 fixed CPG baseline
conditions.change: AHM disabled; phi=0.20 rad/update and alpha=1.10 fixed; same initial oscillator state and source stimuli.

conditions.name: C1 AHM-modulated CPG
conditions.change: Enable bounded H dynamics and set phi=clamp(0.20+0.20*R,0.10,0.45); alpha=1.10 remains fixed.

metrics.name: Measured nod frequency
metrics.measurement: Count positive-going zero crossings of measured nod angle after warm-up; divide by valid observation duration. In simulation use the applied semantic nod trace; on hardware use calibrated encoder or external motion tracking.
metrics.missing_rule: N/A if fewer than two valid crossings or clock/onset identity is unavailable; report valid duration and trial exclusion reason; do not enter zero.

metrics.name: Nod tracking RMSE
metrics.measurement: sqrt(mean((measured_nod_rad-target_nod_rad)^2)) over the predeclared analysis window after aligning clocks with source/trial ID; simulation uses applied command versus target, hardware requires calibrated encoder or external tracker.
metrics.missing_rule: N/A if the measured physical angle, target trace, clock mapping, or minimum 90% of planned samples is missing; retain the raw trial and reason.

controls: Same transition policy, sensor and synthetic input trace IDs, trial duration, initial FSM state and reset procedure across paired conditions.
Same CPG alpha=1.10, dt=0.05 s, initial outputs o1=0.10 and o2=0, warm-up, nod amplitude, pose bounds and output scheduler; only AHM use/phi mapping differs.
Same robot, firmware, sensor placement, battery charge range, surface, environment, participant instructions and calibration protocol for each paired physical comparison.
Use the same software version and interface QoS; log transport delays/drops and do not treat them as physical actuator performance.

parameters.name: AHM update dt
parameters.provenance: Proposed course experiment value; align with Lab03 CPG time step.

parameters.name: AHM stimulus S
parameters.value: 0 at rest; 1 during the predeclared interaction block; identical source IDs in paired conditions
parameters.provenance: Proposed protocol; not a measured biological signal.

parameters.name: SO(2) recurrent gain alpha
parameters.provenance: Lab03 baseline proposed course model; held constant.

parameters.name: SO(2) phase increment phi
parameters.provenance: Lab03 baseline plus proposed bounded AHM integration.

parameters.name: Semantic nod amplitude
parameters.provenance: Proposed course mapping only; physical range must be identified and calibrated for the selected robot.

parameters.name: Semantic actuator response time constant
parameters.provenance: Proposed first-order simulation parameter for ahm_cpg_project.py; not measured from hardware.

parameters.name: ROS 2 QoS
parameters.provenance: Lab07 interface contract; must be checked against each real endpoint.

simulation_plan: Implemented paired C0/C1 simulation in ahm_cpg_project.py with seeds 41,42,43; 10 s warm-up, 10 s stimulus and 30 s analysis window. Store target/applied semantic nod traces, H/R/phi, source IDs, configs, metrics and SHA256 manifest in results/project_ahm_cpg_v2. Lab07 offline bridge transport results remain separate under results/completed and are virtual single-process data, not ROS/DDS. This experiment's actuator is a proposed first-order semantic model, not a physical motor model.
real_robot_plan: No robot model, motor driver, MCU, or encoder is identified in the current workspace. After the instructor names the platform, map semantic radian targets to its calibrated actuator interface; bench-test with actuators disabled, then low-energy movement in a guarded area under instructor supervision. Calibrate neutral, direction, per-axis range, slew and encoder/tracker before testing; use driver watchdog and accessible emergency stop. Run at least three paired trials per condition only after approval and calibration; measure angle physically. This is a future protocol, not an experiment completed here.
clock_correlation_plan: Every planned trial uses trial_id, source_id and local sequence in host-side sidecar logs. On simulation one virtual monotonic timeline is shared. On ROS/hardware, record monotonic timestamps at sensor acquisition, MCU publish, host receipt, decision, command publish/receipt and measured motion; synchronize host/MCU clocks using a documented method and estimate offset/drift/error bound before comparing. The existing Bool/String/Float32 messages lack Header/identity, so source-to-physical latency remains N/A until a sequence-bearing wrapper or correlated sidecar plus validated clock mapping is implemented.
safety_stop_plan: Instructor/operator is present with an accessible hardware emergency stop and independent driver watchdog. Begin motors disabled; verify sensor invalid/stale fallback and stop path before enabling. Stop immediately for unexpected motion, exceeded calibrated range/slew, loss of communication, collision risk, participant discomfort, or any fault; retain logs and record the reason. No real-robot trial is authorized by this proposal alone.
order_counterbalancing: Three paired blocks per platform; each block uses one seed/input trace under both C0 and C1. Counterbalance order C0-C1, C1-C0, C0-C1 across blocks; reset and recheck initial state/calibration before each trial, and record order and startup offset.
paired_seed_or_participant_plan: Simulation: paired seeds 41,42,43, identical source trace per condition. Human/robot stage: recruit only after instructor/institutional approval and informed consent; participant IDs pseudonymized. Each participant completes paired C0/C1 blocks with counterbalanced order; no identifiable video/data unless separately approved. Repeat count is a pilot minimum, not a powered population claim.
expected_input_ids_before_run: Predeclare button_01, touch_01, approach_01, clear_01, near_01, clear_02, button_02 plus touch_conflict, invalid_01, stale_01. Primary interaction denominator is the seven IDs listed first; retain all ten outcomes and report missing/censored separately.
timeline: Completed: offline AHM-CPG proposed-model implementation and paired simulation; Lab07 transport simulation; Ubuntu 24.04/ROS 2 Jazzy WSL setup; colcon build and 22 s synthetic ROS smoke/rosbag run. Remaining: confirm exact Lec5 AHM/CPG reference and approved robot/MCU; conduct instructor-led bench calibration and emergency-stop verification. Only after written safety/ethics approval schedule 12 ten-minute scenario trials (3 repeats x 2 conditions x 2 platforms), plus reset/break time; this is at least 120 minutes of scenario time. Analyze locked metrics, missingness and paired effects. No real-robot or participant dates are set until platform and approvals are confirmed.
